meta_title: DailyCumulus: a cute, ad-free mood diary for iPhone and Android
meta_description: Tap Mongle, pick how you feel, and you're done. Add a note or a photo if you want. No ads, ever. Made by Mauve Labs.
og_title: DailyCumulus: a little diary for how you're actually feeling
og_description: Tap Mongle, pick a mood, done. No ads, no pressure.
hero_title: A little diary for how you're actually feeling.
hero_lede: Tap Mongle, pick how you feel, and that's it. Want to say more? Add a note or a photo. No ads, no pressure.
hero_fine: Free to download · iPhone and Android
moods_sub: Mongle is a little cloud whose face changes with your mood. On rough days, it just keeps you company.
mood_5_line: You got through today, and that's enough.
step_1_body: Pick a mood, then tap how you felt and what you did. Writing is totally optional.
step_1_alt: Choosing a mood, feelings and activities in DailyCumulus
step_2_body: Every day adds a petal in that day's mood color. By the end of the month, your feelings have grown into a flower.
step_2_alt: A flower grown from a month of moods in DailyCumulus
step_gradient_title: Keep every month as a gradient
step_gradient_body: When a month ends, all its mood colors blend into one soft gradient. Collect twelve and that's your year.
step_3_title: Find out what makes your day better
step_3_body: Your stats show what tends to happen on your good days, like seeing friends or getting a workout in.
step_3_alt: DailyCumulus stats showing what lifts your mood
promise_1_line: We don't show ads, and we don't sell your data.
promise_2_line: Only sign in if you want a backup.
promise_3_line: They're sent over an encrypted connection and tied to your account.
soon_body: Stickers, washi tape, and doodles are on the way. Make your diary as cute as you want.
made_by: DailyCumulus is made by Mauve Labs, a small indie app studio.
also_from: We also make Routiny, a habit tracker where a plant grows as you stick to your routines.

sup_meta_description: Get help with DailyCumulus: contact us, manage your subscription, restore purchases, request a refund, or delete your account.
sup_lede: Questions, bugs, or ideas? Email us. A real person on our small team reads every message.
sup_q_cancel: How do I cancel my subscription?
sup_a_cancel: Subscriptions are managed by Apple or Google. iPhone: Settings › your name › Subscriptions › DailyCumulus. Android: Google Play Store › your profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions. Deleting the app or your account doesn't cancel it.
sup_q_restore: I got a new phone. How do I get Premium back?
sup_a_restore: Install DailyCumulus, sign in with the same account, then open Premium and tap Restore purchases. Use the same Apple ID or Google account you paid with.
sup_a_refund: Payments go through the App Store or Google Play, so refunds are handled there: Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com, Google from your Google Play order history. If you were charged twice or something went wrong on our side, email us. Details are in our Terms.
sup_q_delete: How do I delete my account?
sup_a_delete: In the app, go to Profile › Settings › Delete account. You can also request deletion here.
sup_a_privacy: On the free plan, your entries stay on your phone. With Premium, they're also backed up to the cloud. Read our Privacy Policy.
sup_crisis: DailyCumulus is a personal journal, not a medical or mental health service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 (US) or your local emergency number.
